stdout:
List channel sections. Use this tool to list channel sections.

Usage:
  yutu channelSection list [flags]

Examples:
# List my channel sections
yutu channelSection list --mine
# List channel sections by channel ID
yutu channelSection list --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw
# List specific channel sections in JSON format
yutu channelSection list --ids abc123,def456 --output json

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string                Return the ChannelSections owned by the specified channel id
  -h, --help                            help for list
  -l, --hl string                       Return content in specified language
  -i, --ids strings                     Return the channel sections with the given ids
  -M, --mine                            Return the ChannelSections owned by the authenticated user
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                   Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet])
